name: Auth Bypass Detection
description: Detects authentication bypass by removing Authorization headers and checking for 200 OK responses.
author: Daniel Lewis

issues.name: Authentication Bypass
issues.detail: Removing the Authorization header still returned 200 OK. This could indicate a potential authentication bypass vulnerability.
issues.background: Authentication bypass occurs when a protected resource is accessible without proper credentials. This may allow unauthorized users to access restricted data or functionality.
issues.remediation: Ensure that all protected resources enforce authentication and authorization properly.
issues.remediation_background: To mitigate this issue, implement strict authentication checks at both the client and server levels. Consider using session tokens, OAuth, or API key verification.
